---
name: Proof network access request
about: Ask for a user token for the Ziren proof network
title: "Proof network access: <project or team>"
labels: access-request
assignees: ''

---

Do not post a token, key or any other secret in this issue. The token is sent to you privately.

**Who is asking**
The project, team or person, and a contact the token can be delivered to privately.

**What you will prove**
The program or guest (for example a client, a rollup, a benchmark) and roughly how many proofs a day.

**Proof kinds**
Compressed, Groth16, or compressed converted to Groth16.

**GPU needs**
Expected cycles per proof and how many proofs may run at the same time.
